mistakes.text: If durians don't smell so strongly, customs would probably let them through.
mistakes.normalized: if durians don't smell so strongly customs would probably let them through
mistakes.feedback_sk: Situácia je nereálna, preto v Second Conditional patrí po „if“ Past Simple: „didn't smell“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Situace je nereálná, proto ve Second Conditional patří po „if“ Past Simple: „didn't smell“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The situation is unreal, so Second Conditional uses Past Simple after “if”: “didn't smell”.

mistakes.text: If durians wouldn't smell so strongly, customs would probably let them through.
mistakes.normalized: if durians wouldn't smell so strongly customs would probably let them through
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Second Conditional sa po „if“ „would“ nepíše; správne je „if durians didn't smell“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Ve Second Conditional se po „if“ „would“ nepíše; správně je „if durians didn't smell“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In Second Conditional don't use “would” after “if”; say “if durians didn't smell”.

mistakes.text: If durians didn't smell so strongly, customs will probably let them through.
mistakes.normalized: if durians didn't smell so strongly customs will probably let them through
mistakes.feedback_sk: Nereálny následok vyjadruje „would“: „would probably let“, nie „will“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Nereálný následek vyjadřuje „would“: „would probably let“, ne „will“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An unreal result needs “would”: “would probably let”, not “will”.

mistakes.text: If durians didn't smell so strongly, customs would probably let through them.
mistakes.normalized: if durians didn't smell so strongly customs would probably let through them
mistakes.feedback_sk: Zámeno stojí pred časticou: „let them through“, nie „let through them“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Zájmeno stojí před částicí: „let them through“, ne „let through them“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A pronoun goes before the particle: “let them through”, not “let through them”.

mistakes.text: If durians smelled not so strongly, customs would probably let them through.
mistakes.normalized: if durians smelled not so strongly customs would probably let them through
mistakes.feedback_sk: Zápor v Past Simple sa tvorí pomocou „didn't“: „didn't smell“, nie „smelled not“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Zápor v Past Simple se tvoří pomocí „didn't“: „didn't smell“, ne „smelled not“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Past Simple negatives use “didn't”: “didn't smell”, not “smelled not”.
